notes.title: Cheating is now enabled and bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed bug for older MACs and those that might encounter this weird thing,

  File "renpy/common/00voice.rpy", line 360, in voice_interact
    if _menu:
NameError: global name '_menu' is not defined

Also added a cheating message to instantly max half of the stats bars.

If anyone still encounter the '_menu' is not defined bug, please let us know and please accept our deepest apologies.
